scope: same 20 already-routed directly observed paired cases only
unchanged: all modeled, identical-route, and staged cases
reported_metrics: sum of omitted actual timer costs relative to look-33 observations
additional observations required relative to the old look schedule
unavailable prefixes or any decision disagreement
interpretation_limit: diagnostic policy-selection estimate only; no requalification and no cross-case claim
selection_rule: retain default look 5 unless the alternative independently supports at least 120 seconds absolute timer savings with no unresolved extra sampling or decision disagreement
execution: no benchmark, runtime edit, or second full run
